user.title: Connect to AutoLedger
user.description: Enter your AutoLedger server details and personal access token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure AutoLedger
reconfigure.description: Update your AutoLedger server details and personal access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate AutoLedger
reauth_confirm.description: AutoLedger at {host} no longer accepts the API token. Enter a new token.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the AutoLedger server. Check host URL.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please verify your API token.
error.invalid_scope: This token cannot send data to AutoLedger. Create an API token with the 'ingest' or 'homeassistant' scope.

abort.already_configured: This AutoLedger server is already configured.

user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: Pick the AutoLedger vehicle. Choosing its Home Assistant device lets the next step suggest the sensors.

mapping.title: Sensors of {vehicle_name}
mapping.description:
Tell AutoLedger which Home Assistant entities describe this vehicle. All of them are optional.

{preview_section}

error.invalid_battery_unit: Battery SoC sensor unit must be '%'.
error.invalid_odometer_unit: Odometer sensor unit must be a distance ('km' or 'mi').
error.invalid_numeric_state: The selected entity state must be a valid number.
error.invalid_battery_range: Battery SoC must be between 0% and 100%.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the AutoLedger server. Check that it is reachable, then try again.
abort.invalid_auth: The AutoLedger server rejected the API token. Re-enter it from the connection settings.
abort.no_vehicle_available: No vehicle left to add: every vehicle of the AutoLedger account is already configured, or the account has none.

station.title: Charging station
station.description:
Name the station and point at the entity that tells when it is charging and, if you have one, its energy meter.

{preview_section}

data.energy_meter_type: Energy counter mode (detected when left empty)
data.debounce_seconds: Pause tolerated before a charge ends (seconds)

assignment.title: Which vehicle is charging?
assignment.description: Choose how the charges of this station are attributed to AutoLedger vehicles.

assignment_vehicle.title: Linked vehicle
assignment_vehicle.description: Every charge of this station is attributed to this vehicle.

assignment_entity.title: Vehicle selector
assignment_entity.description: The entity whose state names the vehicle being charged.

error.invalid_name: Please enter a valid charger name.
error.invalid_energy_unit: Energy meter unit must be an energy unit ('kWh' or 'Wh'). Do not select instantaneous power (kW/W).
error.invalid_numeric_state: The selected entity state must be a valid number.
error.invalid_energy_range: Energy meter value cannot be negative.

abort.no_vehicle_configured: Add a vehicle first: a fixed assignment needs one.

sync.name: Sync with AutoLedger
sync.description: Forces an immediate refresh of vehicle metrics and charge statistics from the AutoLedger server.

submit_charge.name: Submit Charging Session
submit_charge.description: Manually submit or automate logging of a charging session into AutoLedger.

log_trip.name: Log Trip
log_trip.description: Manually log a trip with its start and end position. The distance comes from the odometer values.
